newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - July 31.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - July 31.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Britain's Vosper Thornycroft has along with several other shipbuilders put in its latest bid for six patrol boats for the UAE navy, a contract which is estimated to be worth $600 million.
- Recent swings in international foreign exchange markets have helped the UAE dirham appreciate considerably against most major currencies worldwide.
- A UAE study showed the percentage of women in the labour force has risen to 12 percent in 1995 from 5.3 percent in 1980.
- Union National Bank recorded a net profit of almost 48 million dirhams in the first half of 1997, an increase of about 10 million dirhams on the last six months of 1996.
- The Bahrain Telecommunications Co (Batelco) has signed a contract with GPT International of Britain for the supply of an Intelligent Network system.
- Saudi Arabia's Prince al-Waleed is investing in a Palestinian construction and development firm with a capital of $100 million.
